v1CollectionMetadata.title: Metadata that will be returned with each collection-level GET

rating_id.description: Unique identifier for the exchange rating; automatically generated.

exchange_id.description: Unique ID of the exchange item.

exchange_output_ids.description: Output IDs from extractive output for the generated answer; defaults to best_1; answers deemed chit-chat are ignored.

creator_id.description: Unique identifier for the user who provided feedback; output field, automatically populated.

question.description: Question asked for the rated exchange; output only, automatically populated.

rank.description: Rank value given by the user; valid responses are 1 (negative) and 5 (positive).

message.description: User comment that provides additional context on the rating.

freeform_text.description: Optional freeform text for feedback provider.

knowledge_domain_id.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge domain that supplied the exchange response; autogenerated and not editable.

reviewer_ids.description: Unique identifiers of the reviewing authorities that viewed/inspected the item; output only, automatically populated.

flagged.description: Item noted by reviewing authorities upon inspection; intentionally vague and left to the API to use as necessary.

approval_id.description: Approval item for exchange event; output only; automatically populated.

v1GenerativeExchangeRatingReview.title: Authority perspective of an Exchange Rating

v1GenerativeExchangeRatingReviewStatus.description:
- UNSPECIFIED: Not a valid exchange rating value.
 - PENDING: Waiting to be inspected for approval or rejection.
 - COMPLETE: Inspected and acted upon; no further action required.

order_by.description: From the request; same as order by.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the interaction returned in the resource response; the response ID.

update_time.description: Time of the last update; 0 indicates updates have never been made.
